text:
What is a property of aqueous ethanoic acid?
A
It changes red litmus blue.
B
It has a deep purple colour.
C
It has a pH of less than 7.
D
It reacts with a metal oxide to form carbon dioxide.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a deep purple colour.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a pH of less than 7.

options.label: D
options.text: It reacts with a metal oxide to form carbon dioxide.
